packageRules.description: Keep workflow action bumps together in a single PR.
The Home Assistant validation actions track their upstream branch on purpose so new rules apply on the next run; do not pin them to a digest.
Keep the test dependency bumps together in a single PR.
Keep the frontend dependency bumps together in a single PR, majors stay separate.
Keep the dev container image bumps together in a single PR.
josepy is held below 2.0 on purpose in requirements_test.txt.
Python follows the version Home Assistant runs on. Revisit when HA moves to 3.15.
